name: motion-walk-cycle
title: Walk Cycle
description: Nhân vật bước đều: thân nhún hai lần mỗi chu kỳ, tay chân đánh ngược pha nhau.

moworks.author: moworks

options.bob: units (5): low at contact, high at passing

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: 1000 ms cycle = 2 steps (0.5 s each): body bobs |cos(phase)| x 5 px (low at contact, high at passing, twice per cycle); legs swing +-0.5 rad and arms -+0.6 rad on opposite-phase sines; loops. Params: step (0.5 s) · bob (5 px) · swing chân / tay (0.5 / 0.6 rad).
